title: NEXY 215-system exhaustive audit prompt
scope: Integrate the user's complete 215-system NEXY inventory into a Thai-language audit-only prompt that re-verifies each system against the attached design/spec and current GitHub repository, produces detailed status tables, and generates create/fix commands for a separate executor.
inputs_summary: User supplied 215 named systems with spec/code hints and seed statuses across Core/UI, DOC-C/vNEXT, Vault, Sovereign/Universe, constitutional layers, Game/NCF, L1o, Lo3, Lo2, Robotics, Final 10-Layer Architecture, and cross-system mechanisms.
actions: Marked user-provided statuses as seed observations requiring re-verification
Added detailed per-system and cross-system audit tables
Added CREATE command generation only for current-required missing systems
Added FIX command generation for fail/partial/conflict systems
Added repeated clean-audit loop and no-premature-completion rules

claims_proofs.claim: All 215 user-listed systems must appear in the audit registry and final tables.
claims_proofs.proof: Direct user instruction and supplied inventory.

claims_proofs.claim: Seed statuses must be re-verified against current evidence before treated as current truth.
claims_proofs.proof: Project truth law requires current evidence and prohibits stale/fake pass.

tests_results: Prompt-generation task only; no implementation audit executed.
successes: Integrated all 215 systems into one audit prompt architecture.
decisions: No protected branch is defined in this version.
Historical/deferred/excluded/scope-conflict systems remain in inventory but only CURRENT_REQUIRED systems can trigger CREATE commands.
Use the user-supplied code/spec/status fields as audit seeds, not final verdicts.
unresolved: Actual target GitHub branch and current HEAD must be resolved at audit runtime.
risks: Hardcoding old statuses as truth would stale quickly; prompt explicitly forces re-verification.
limits: This task creates the audit command, not audit results.
next_actions: Run the prompt in the dedicated NEXY audit chat with design file attached and GitHub connected.
dependencies: GitHub read access to NEXY.AI repository
